scripts.start: pnpm --filter @magi/core build && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && node dist/index.js
scripts.start:opentui: pnpm --filter @magi/core build && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && node dist/opentui-info.js
scripts.start:opentui:info: pnpm --filter @magi/core build && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && node dist/opentui-info.js
scripts.start:opentui:native: pnpm --filter @magi/core build && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && MAGI_OPENTUI_NATIVE=1 node --import 'data:text/javascript,import { register } from "node:module"; import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url"; register("./dist/opentui-node-loader.js", pathToFileURL("./"));' dist/opentui-index.js
